references.notes: Klemetsrud Plant is the largest waste-to-energy operations in Norway. It produces district heating and electricity by recov­ering waste from both households and industrial actors. The plant is strategically located to be easily accessible, thus reducing both transportation costs and emissions. For every tonne of garbage processed at an energy-from-waste facility, roughly a tonne of emitted carbon-dioxide equivalent in the atmosphere is avoided.
